purpose: Teach: その道/エゴ/やう/正午/未明/ナンセンス/アンタ/初歩

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コーヒーのその道の専門家でいらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer earlier really knew their coffee, didn't they?
lines.style: Warm observational tone. Soft, conversational opening. A small smile in the voice. Unhurried, like sharing a quiet moment between tasks.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のエゴが強すぎる時もご対応丁寧にしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: But when customers get a bit demanding, you've handled them so gracefully every time.
lines.style: Steady, encouraging without being saccharine. Gentle emphasis on 'gracefully.' A beat of real recognition. Warm but not over-the-top.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、メニューを「やう」って読まれてたよ、古文好きなのね、メイちゃん
lines.en: And did you catch them reading the menu like it was classical Japanese? Bit of a literature buff, that one.
lines.style: Light, amused undertone. Knowing half-laugh tucked into the delivery. Conspiratorial—shared observation between friends. Not unkind.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、正午のランチタイムは忙しいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The noon rush is always hectic, isn't it?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact acknowledgment. Sympathetic but practical. A touch of understanding fatigue. Stated as shared reality, not complaint.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、未明から仕込みを始めようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Maybe we should start prepping earlier, before dawn.
lines.style: Thoughtful, problem-solving tone. Gentle suggestion rather than demand. Collaborative—'we' not 'you.' Calm, steady pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店をディスるレビューはナンセンスだね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Those bad reviews about the shop are pretty ridiculous, honestly.
lines.style: Dry, slight edge of wry humor. Quick, emphatic on 'ridiculous.' Not bitter—just matter-of-fact pushback. Defending without drama.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様に「アンタ」呼ばわりは絶対しないようにね、メイちゃん
lines.en: And whatever you do, don't call customers 'you' in that rough way. Never.
lines.style: Firmer than before. Clear boundary-setting. Not scolding—protective, making sure she knows what matters. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新人スタッフに初歩から教えていこうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We'll walk the new staff through the basics, nice and slow.
lines.style: Reassuring, patient rhythm. Inclusive 'we'—partnership tone. Steady, grounded. Closes gently, like a plan that's already settled.
